note: The honesty log: real incidents (annual loss, GBP) and near-misses (events the control caught before a loss) per institution, 5 years. This is what makes the £ falsifiable — calibration.py back-tests the FAIR model against these actuals and Bühlmann-recalibrates. Authored so the estate exercises BOTH recalibration directions: driftwood runs hot (actuals above the model -> recalibrate up), ludlow runs cold (strict controls -> actuals below the model -> recalibrate down). Scenarios referenced are the real per-org scenarios already in the estate; a loss year with 0 means no loss event landed that year.

driftwood.source: driftwood SecOps incident register + WAF blocked-skimmer counts

tuppence.source: tuppence fraud-ops loss ledger + FCA reportable near-misses

ludlow.source: ludlow HIPAA breach log + break-glass audit (near-misses = caught mis-access)
